title: The No-Chasing Rule

launchpad.outcome: Write a no-chase rule with no loophole, and recognize the loophole when it talks.
launchpad.missionQuestion: Is my rule specific enough that live-trading-me can’t argue with it?

rows.text: PIL. The retest happens. You miss it.

options.label: Only the price
options.feedback: The price changed everything else too.

options.label: Entry, risk/reward and execution, and the emotion is rising
options.why: Planned entry 20,000. Current price 20,020. The trade you planned no longer exists.

slides.title: Close the loophole

options.text: I’ll only chase if it really looks strong.
options.feedback: “Really” is a loophole with a bow on it. 😂

options.text: If my valid Dayli ICC retest entry is missed and price moves away, I do not market-enter late. I wait for a new valid setup.
options.why: CLEAR · TRIGGERED · ACTIONABLE · DECIDED IN ADVANCE.

options.text: I’ll be more patient next time.
options.feedback: Nothing triggers it and nothing tells you what to do instead.

slides.customLabel: Keep this one, or write it in your words. It saves to MY AGHF RULEBOOK.

slides.title: The loophole talking
slides.thought: “I’m not chasing. I’m just entering a little late.”

asks.prompt: GIRL. 😭 Was the planned execution opportunity missed?
Are you entering because price is leaving?

options.label: No, it’s analysis
options.feedback: The analysis was the retest. This is the leaving.

rule.label: MY NO-CHASE RULE
rule.text: If my retest entry is missed and price moves away, I do not market-enter late.

slides.quote: “A little late” is still late. Your rule already decided.

slides.prompt: Write your no-chase rule in one sentence.
slides.modelAnswer: If my valid Dayli ICC retest entry is missed and price moves away, I do not market-enter late. I wait for a new valid setup.

takeaways: A strong rule: clear, triggered, actionable, decided in advance.
remember: MISSING THE ENTRY DOES NOT GIVE YOU PERMISSION TO INVENT A NEW ONE.
